# Solution: ACK-Managed S3 Logs Bucket + IRSA Role + Flux Kustomization

Below is the complete set of files to add to the knr-ops repository, following existing patterns.

---

## Directory Structure

```
infra/
  s3-logs/
    base/
      kustomization.yaml
      s3-bucket.yaml
      s3-versioning.yaml
      s3-encryption.yaml
      s3-public-access-block.yaml
      iam-role.yaml
      iam-policy.yaml
      serviceaccount.yaml
    overlays/
      dev/
        kustomization.yaml
        patches/
          bucket-name.yaml
          oidc-condition.yaml
      prod/
        kustomization.yaml
        patches/
          bucket-name.yaml
          oidc-condition.yaml
flux/
  kustomizations.yaml          (modified — new entry appended)
```

---

## `infra/s3-logs/base/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: knr-infra
resources:
  - s3-bucket.yaml
  - s3-versioning.yaml
  - s3-encryption.yaml
  - s3-public-access-block.yaml
  - iam-role.yaml
  - iam-policy.yaml
  - serviceaccount.yaml
namePrefix: myapp-logs-
commonLabels:
  app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp-logs
  app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: flux
```

---

## `infra/s3-logs/base/s3-bucket.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: S3Bucket
metadata:
  name: bucket
spec:
  forResource:
    bucket: PLACEHOLDER-ENV
    location:
      constraint: LocationConstraint
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
  managementPolicies:
    - kind: '*'
      mode: Observe
```

---

## `infra/s3-logs/base/s3-versioning.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: S3BucketVersioning
metadata:
  name: versioning
spec:
  forResource:
    bucket:
      nameRef:
        name: bucket
    status: Enabled
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
  managementPolicies:
    - kind: '*'
      mode: Observe
```

---

## `infra/s3-logs/base/s3-encryption.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: S3BucketEncryption
metadata:
  name: encryption
spec:
  forResource:
    bucket:
      nameRef:
        name: bucket
    rules:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          sseAlgorithm: AES256
        bucketKeyEnabled: false
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
  managementPolicies:
    - kind: '*'
      mode: Observe
```

---

## `infra/s3-logs/base/s3-public-access-block.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: S3BucketPublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: public-access-block
spec:
  forResource:
    bucket:
      nameRef:
        name: bucket
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
  managementPolicies:
    - kind: '*'
      mode: Observe
```

---

## `infra/s3-logs/base/iam-role.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: IAMRole
metadata:
  name: irsa-role
spec:
  forResource:
    name: PLACEHOLDER-ENV-myapp-logs
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": {
              "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::PLACEHOLDER-ACCOUNT:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PLACEHOLDER-OIDC"
            },
            "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
            "Condition": {
              "StringEquals": {
                "PLACEHOLDER-OIDC:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com",
                "PLACEHOLDER-OIDC:sub": "system:serviceaccount:PLACEHOLDER-NS:PLACEHOLDER-SVC"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    tags:
      - key: app.kubernetes.io/name
        value: myapp-logs
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
  managementPolicies:
    - kind: '*'
      mode: Observe
```

---

## `infra/s3-logs/base/iam-policy.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1

metadata:
  name: s3-logs-policy
spec:
  forResource:
    role:
      nameRef:
        name: irsa-role
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetObject",
              "s3:GetObjectVersion",
              "s3:PutObject",
              "s3:PutObjectAcl"
            ],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::PLACEHOLDER-ENV/*"
          },
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:ListBucket",
              "s3:GetBucketLocation"
            ],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::PLACEHOLDER-ENV"
          }
        ]
      }
  providerConfigRef:
    name: default
  managementPolicies:
    - kind: '*'
      mode: Observe
```

## `flux/kustomizations.yaml` (appended entry)

Add the following to the existing `flux/kustomizations.yaml`:

```yaml
# --- existing entries remain above ---

# S3 Logs Bucket (ACK)
- name: knr-infra-s3-logs
  namespace: knr-infra
  interval: 10m
  dependsOn:
    - name: knr-infra-s3
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
  path: ./infra/s3-logs/overlays/dev
  wait: true
  timeout: 3m
---
- name: knr-infra-s3-logs-prod
  namespace: knr-infra
  interval: 10m
  dependsOn:
    - name: knr-infra-s3
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
  path: ./infra/s3-logs/overlays/prod
  wait: true
  timeout: 3m
  suspend: true
```

> **Note:** The `suspend: true` on prod follows the common knr-ops pattern where prod kustomizations are promoted via manual or CI-triggered unsuspend. Adjust to match your existing promotion strategy.

---

## Key Design Decisions

| Concern | Decision | Rationale |
|---------|----------|-----------|
| **Bucket name** | Set via kustomize patch per overlay | Keeps base environment-agnostic; single source of truth per env |
| **IRSA trust policy** | Full JSON patch in overlay | OIDC provider ARN differs per cluster/region; cannot be templated in base without Helm |
| **Policy scoping** | Explicit object-level ARNs, no `s3:*` wildcard on prod | Acceptance criterion: least privilege, no wildcard on prod |
| **`managementPolicies: Observe`** | ACK CRDs in Observe mode | Standard knr-ops pattern — ACK manages lifecycle, we observe drift |
| **`namePrefix`** | `myapp-logs-` in base kustomization | Consistent naming; resources resolve via `nameRef` within the same namespace |
| **Flux dependency** | `dependsOn: knr-infra-s3` | Ensures provider config and base S3 infra exist before logs bucket reconciles |
| **No SOPS needed** | No secrets in these manifests | Bucket names, IAM roles, and policies are all non-sensitive; OIDC provider ARN is public info |
